Using the first reference image as the exact character identity: it shows a small coral
pixel critter (the Anthropic "Clawd" pixel mascot) — a front-facing stepped blocky coral
body with a raised head block, two black square eyes, one small stub arm on each side of the
mid-body, and four little legs dangling below. Redraw THIS SAME CRITTER as an adorable ANGEL
version of itself, in a cute designed-sticker pixel-art style: crisp flat blocky pixel
shapes with a soft, plush, charming energy — not a rigid grid port, not mushy painterly
rendering, not 3D, not glossy.

THE CRITTER: same identity as the reference — a stepped, blocky coral body (coral #DD775B,
slightly darker #c05f45 shading low on the body, a lighter #ea9077 highlight band near the
top), two big dark rounded eyes each with a single small white glint, and little dangling
pixel legs hanging below the body as it floats.

THE ANGEL: classic scalloped angel wings growing from BEHIND the body, one on each side —
cream and off-white (#fffdf7 / #f3ead9) feathers in neat scalloped rows. The wings attach
behind the body; they are never held and never attach in front.

ACCESSORY: it holds a small pixel checkered racing flag exactly like the one in the SECOND reference image, mounted the same way — the little pole gripped by its small right side-stub — AND a simple golden-cream pixel halo floats just above its head, with the angel wings spread behind it. No heart.

COMPOSITION: the critter floats centered, large in frame, entirely surrounded by background.
BACKGROUND: a single flat solid field of pure bright green #00FF00 and nothing else — no
shadow, no reflection, no surface, no gradient, no vignette; the green touches all four edges.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, no letters, no numbers.
